elements.title: Administrative Safeguards
elements.text: Defined in the Security Rule as the “administrative actions and policies, and procedures to manage the selection, development, implementation, and maintenance of security measures to protect electronic protected health information and to manage the conduct of the covered entity's workforce in relation to the protection of that information.”

elements.title: Physical Safeguards
elements.text: Defined as the “physical measures, policies, and procedures to protect a covered entity’s electronic information systems and related buildings and equipment, from natural and environmental hazards, and unauthorized intrusion.”

elements.title: Technical Safeguards
elements.text: Defined as the “the technology and the policy and procedures for its use that protect electronic protected health information and control access to it.”

elements.title: Organizational Requirements
elements.text: Includes standards for business associate contracts and other arrangements between a covered entity and a business associate and between a business associate and a subcontractor, as well as requirements for group health plans.

elements.title: Policies and Procedures and Documentation Requirements
elements.text: Requires the implementation of reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures to comply with the standards, implementation specifications, and other requirements of the Security Rule; the maintenance of written (may be electronic) documentation and/or records that include the policies, procedures, actions, activities, or assessments required by the Security Rule; and retention, availability, and update requirements related to the documentation.
